title: SIDE STORY: MARIA NEARL RERUN
lines: 01 SIDE STORY: MARIA NEARL RERUN
EVENT DURATION: March 31, 2022, 10:00 (UTC-7) – April 14, 2022, 03:59 (UTC-7)
UNLOCK REQUIREMENT: Clear Main Storyline 1-10
DETAILS: Maria Nearl event stages will be open for a limited time. Players can obtain event rewards by clearing event stages, completing the event missions, and redeeming from the event shop.
EVENT STAGES DURATION:
[Jousting Arena] Duration: March 31, 2022, 10:00 (UTC-7) – April 10, 2022, 03:59 (UTC-7)
[Gloompincer Cage] Duration: March 31, 2022, 10:00 (UTC-7) – April 10, 2022, 03:59 (UTC-7)
[OFFSITE ACTIVITY VENUE]
DETAILS: During the event, players can complete missions in the Offsite Activity Venue to obtain rewards by clearing event stages.
MAIN REWARDS: ★★★★★: Whislash, Nearls' Living Room Replica Furniture (Pieces), Mieszko Sports Securities.
[DUTY-FREE SHOP]
DURATION: March 31, 2022, 10:00 (UTC-7) – April 14, 2022, 03:59 (UTC-7)

DETAILS: During the event, players can obtain Mieszko Sports Securities by clearing event stages and the Offsite Activity Venue. Mieszko Sports Securities can be used to redeem items from Duty-Free Shop.

MAIN REWARDS: Whislash's Token, Dreambind Castle Collection - Cleansweeper in the Castle for Shaw, Nearls' Living Room Replica Furniture (Pieces), Headhunting Permit, LMD, Furniture Parts, Elite Materials, etc.
NOTE:
The requirements to obtain certain medals of this event have been updated. Players who have participated in the original event and
met the adjusted requirements will receive the corresponding medals once log in.
Once the rerun ends, the Medal Set of this event can no longer be obtained via any method, including the [Side Story].
This event rerun will carry on the stage progress and First Clear progress.

The once-only rewards in the rerun will automatically be converted to Intelligence Certificates for players who have already claimed them. Please refer to [Intelligence Certificate Exchange Info] for more details.
[Intelligence Certificate Area] will be restocked as the event rerun begins. In addition, new redeemable will be added.
Operators Blemishine, Aosta, Whislash, and Bubble will gain more trust during the event rerun.
After the event rerun ends, this event will be archived into [Side Story] and become permanently available.
02 LIMITED-TIME HEADHUNTING RERUN – FRACTURED LIGHT
DURATION: March 31, 2022, 10:00 (UTC-7) – April 14, 2022, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, the Limited-time Headhunting, "Fractured Light", opens and the following Operators will appear at a higher rate from this Standard Headhunting:
★★★★★★: Blemishine
★★★★★: Aosta / Platinum
★★★★: Bubble
03 LIMITED-TIME LOGIN EVENT: TIDINGS FROM AFAR OPEN
DURATION: April 1, 2022, 04:00 (UTC-7) – April 11, 2022, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, players can log in for 7 days to earn the following rewards.
Day 1: Handmade Wooden Mobile Ladder * 1, LMD * 30000
Day 2: Orundum * 200, Skill Summary - 3 * 15
Day 3: Top Emergency Sanity Potion * 2, Pure Gold * 20
Day 4: Tactical Battle Record * 25, RMA70-12 * 3
Day 5: Orundum * 200, Recruitment Permit * 5
Day 6: Originite Prime * 1, LMD * 30000
Day 7: EPOQUE Collection - Bard's Holiday for Meteor * 1, Strategic Battle Record * 20
NOTE:
The Top Emergency Sanity Potion from this event will be expired on April 18, 2022, 03:59 (UTC-7)
04 EPOQUE COLLECTION NEW ARRIVALS AT OUTFIT STORE
DURATION: March 31, 2022, 10:00 (UTC-7) – April 14, 2022, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: The following Outfit will be available at the Store:
EPOQUE Collection - Glory Purple for Whislash
05 DREAMBIND CASTLE COLLECTION RE-EDITION AT OUTFIT STORE
DURATION: March 31, 2022, 10:00 (UTC-7) – April 14, 2022, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: The following Re-edition Outfits will be available at the Store, including:
Dreambind Castle Collection - Dream Within a Dreammare for Phantom
Dreambind Castle Collection - Visionblazer in the Courtyard for Mayer
Dreambind Castle Collection - Exterminator in the Square for Glaucus
06 RE-EDITION FURNITURE SET – NEARLS' LIVING ROOM REPLICA
DURATION: March 31, 2022, 10:00 (UTC-7) – April 14, 2022, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: This furniture set will be available again during the event.
HOW TO OBTAIN:
The Maria Nearl event rewards and redeem in Duty-Free Shop (Pieces)
Limited-time sale at the Store (Pieces)
The furniture pieces of this furniture set will be available at the Store from March 31, 2022, 10:00 (UTC-7) – April 14, 2022, 03:59 (UTC-7)
